panels.description: SIGNAL_RULES: DEMO sampled advisories, not business SLA/native alert severity. CPU mean>=80%, RAM mean>=85%, SQL minimum observed pending grants>0 in three consecutive complete 1m buckets. Unknown breaks run. Negative finding requires >=3 minutes, >=90% occupancy, <=2m longest gap, <=5m age at selected END. Bucket span is not continuous duration; window attention is separate from last-bucket state.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let IntervalStart=$__timeFrom();
let IntervalEnd=$__timeTo();
let FirstBucket=bin(IntervalStart,1m)+iff(IntervalStart>bin(IntervalStart,1m),1m,0m);
let LastBucket=bin(IntervalEnd,1m)-1m;
let WindowApproved=IntervalEnd-IntervalStart>=1m and IntervalEnd-IntervalStart<=4h and FirstBucket<=LastBucket;
let ExpectedMinutes=iff(WindowApproved,toint((LastBucket-FirstBucket)/1m)+1,0);
let SafeFirst=iff(WindowApproved,FirstBucket,IntervalEnd);
let SafeLast=iff(WindowApproved,LastBucket,IntervalEnd-1m);
let buckets=range Bucket from SafeFirst to SafeLast step 1m | where WindowApproved;
let Selected=${machine:singlequote};
let expectedSignals=datatable(Computer:string,Signal:string,Threshold:real,Severity:string)['HV-HOST-01','OS CPU',80.0,'Warning','HV-HOST-01','RAM use',85.0,'Warning','SQL2019-GUEST','OS CPU',80.0,'Warning','SQL2019-GUEST','RAM use',85.0,'Warning','SQL2019-GUEST','SQL pending grants',1e-06,'Critical','WIN2019-GUEST','OS CPU',80.0,'Warning','WIN2019-GUEST','RAM use',85.0,'Warning','WIN2022-GUEST','OS CPU',80.0,'Warning','WIN2022-GUEST','RAM use',85.0,'Warning','WIN2025-GUEST-01','OS CPU',80.0,'Warning','WIN2025-GUEST-01','RAM use',85.0,'Warning','RHEL94-GUEST','OS CPU',80.0,'Warning','RHEL94-GUEST','RAM use',85.0,'Warning'] | where WindowApproved;
let signalPerf=materialize(Perf
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where WindowApproved and TimeGenerated>=IntervalEnd-4h and TimeGenerated<IntervalEnd
| where Computer in~ ('HV-HOST-01','SQL2019-GUEST','WIN2019-GUEST','WIN2022-GUEST','WIN2025-GUEST-01','RHEL94-GUEST')
| where isempty(tolower(tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId','')))) or tolower(tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId',''))) startswith '/subscriptions/<SUBSCRIPTION_ID>/resourcegroups/rg-hyperv-arc-monitor-demo/'
| extend Computer=toupper(Computer)
| where (CounterName=='% Processor Time' and
((ObjectName=='Processor Information' and InstanceName=='_Total')
or (Computer=='RHEL94-GUEST' and ObjectName=='Processor' and InstanceName=='total'))) or (ObjectName=='Memory' and
((Computer!='RHEL94-GUEST' and CounterName=='Available Bytes')
or (Computer=='RHEL94-GUEST' and CounterName=='% Used Memory')))
| extend Signal=iff(CounterName=='% Processor Time' and
((ObjectName=='Processor Information' and InstanceName=='_Total')
or (Computer=='RHEL94-GUEST' and ObjectName=='Processor' and InstanceName=='total')),'OS CPU','RAM use'),Value=iff(CounterName=='% Processor Time' and
((ObjectName=='Processor Information' and InstanceName=='_Total')
or (Computer=='RHEL94-GUEST' and ObjectName=='Processor' and InstanceName=='total')),CounterValue,iff(Computer=='RHEL94-GUEST',CounterValue,100.0*(1.0-CounterValue/(case(Computer=='HV-HOST-01',68719476736.0,Computer=='SQL2019-GUEST',12884901888.0,
Computer in ('WIN2019-GUEST','WIN2022-GUEST','WIN2025-GUEST-01'),8589934592.0,real(null))))))
| where isfinite(Value) and Value>=0 and Value<=100
| project Computer,Signal,Value,TimeGenerated);
let signalSql=HvSqlMemory_CL
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where WindowApproved and TimeGenerated>=IntervalEnd-4h and TimeGenerated<IntervalEnd
| where Computer in~ ('SQL2019-GUEST')
| where isempty(tolower(tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId','')))) or tolower(tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId',''))) startswith '/subscriptions/<SUBSCRIPTION_ID>/resourcegroups/rg-hyperv-arc-monitor-demo/'
| extend Computer=toupper(Computer)
| where Instance=='MSSQLSERVER'
| where isfinite(PendingGrants) and PendingGrants>=0
| project Computer,Signal='SQL pending grants',Value=todouble(PendingGrants),TimeGenerated;
let observed=union signalPerf,signalSql
| summarize Mean=avg(Value),Minimum=min(Value),Peak=max(Value),
    FirstSample=min(TimeGenerated),LastSample=max(TimeGenerated) by Computer,Signal,Bucket=bin(TimeGenerated,1m)
| extend Value=iff(Signal=='SQL pending grants',Minimum,Mean);
let grid=materialize(expectedSignals | extend Key=1
| join kind=inner (buckets | extend Key=1) on Key
| project Computer,Signal,Threshold,Severity,Bucket
| join kind=leftouter observed on Computer,Signal,Bucket
| extend State=case(isnull(Value),'Unknown',Value>=Threshold,'Breach','Observed')
| project Computer,Signal,Threshold,Severity,Bucket,Value,Peak,FirstSample,LastSample,State);
let runs=materialize(grid | sort by Computer asc,Signal asc,Bucket asc | serialize
| extend NewRun=iff(isnull(prev(Bucket)),true,Computer!=prev(Computer) or Signal!=prev(Signal)
    or State!=prev(State) or Bucket!=prev(Bucket)+1m)
| extend RunId=row_cumsum(iff(NewRun,1,0))
| summarize EpisodeStart=min(Bucket),LastBucketInRun=max(Bucket),Minutes=count(),Peak=max(Peak),
    FirstSample=min(FirstSample),LastSample=max(LastSample) by Computer,Signal,Severity,State,RunId
| extend EpisodeEnd=LastBucketInRun+1m);
let episodes=materialize(runs | where State=='Breach' and Minutes>=3);
let quality=grid | summarize ObservedMinutes=countif(State!='Unknown'),LastSample=max(LastSample) by Computer,Signal
| extend CoveragePct=100.0*ObservedMinutes/ExpectedMinutes,AgeMinutes=(IntervalEnd-LastSample)/1m;
let gaps=runs | summarize LongestGapMinutes=maxif(Minutes,State=='Unknown') by Computer,Signal;
let signalQuality=quality | join kind=leftouter gaps on Computer,Signal
| extend LongestGapMinutes=coalesce(LongestGapMinutes,0)
| extend Confidence=iff(ExpectedMinutes>=3 and CoveragePct>=90 and isnotnull(LastSample)
    and AgeMinutes<=5 and LongestGapMinutes<=2,'Adequate','Insufficient');

let evidence=signalQuality | summarize InsufficientSignals=countif(Confidence=='Insufficient'),
ExpectedSignals=count(),MinimumCoveragePct=min(CoveragePct),LongestGapMinutes=max(LongestGapMinutes),
OldestSignalAgeMinutes=max(AgeMinutes) by Computer;
let candidates=episodes | summarize CriticalEpisodes=countif(Severity=='Critical'),
WarningEpisodes=countif(Severity=='Warning'),FirstObserved=min(EpisodeStart),LastObserved=max(EpisodeEnd),
LongestEpisodeMinutes=max(Minutes),ThroughLastCompleteBucket=countif(EpisodeEnd==LastBucket+1m),
Reasons=make_set(Signal,3) by Computer;
datatable(Computer:string,Role:string,FixedRamGiB:real)['HV-HOST-01','Nested host / ROOT OS',64,'SQL2019-GUEST','Guest',12,'WIN2019-GUEST','Guest',8,'WIN2022-GUEST','Guest',8,'WIN2025-GUEST-01','Guest',8,'RHEL94-GUEST','Guest',real(null)] | where WindowApproved
| join kind=leftouter evidence on Computer | join kind=leftouter candidates on Computer
| extend CriticalEpisodes=coalesce(CriticalEpisodes,0),WarningEpisodes=coalesce(WarningEpisodes,0)
| extend Attention=case(CriticalEpisodes>0,'Critical',WarningEpisodes>0,'Warning',
isnull(InsufficientSignals) or InsufficientSignals>0,'Unknown','No observed breach'),
Confidence=iff(isnull(InsufficientSignals) or InsufficientSignals>0,'Insufficient','Adequate'),
EvaluatedSignals=iff(Computer=='SQL2019-GUEST','CPU / RAM / SQL pending grants','CPU / RAM only'),
NotMonitored='Application availability / SQL blocking / storage health threshold',
EpisodeAtEnd=iff(ThroughLastCompleteBucket>0,'Observed through LAST COMPLETE bucket; not live continuity',
'No qualifying run through last complete bucket; not a health assertion'),
Reason=iff(CriticalEpisodes+WarningEpisodes>0,strcat('Observed sampled episodes: ',tostring(Reasons)),
'Negative finding applies ONLY to evaluated signals with adequate confidence'),
AffectedFlag=iff(CriticalEpisodes+WarningEpisodes>0,1,0),UnknownFlag=iff(isnull(InsufficientSignals) or InsufficientSignals>0,1,0),
OpenWorkload='Open',OpenIncident='Investigate'
| project Computer,OpenWorkload,OpenIncident,Attention,Confidence,EvaluatedSignals,NotMonitored,
MinimumCoveragePct,LongestGapMinutes,OldestSignalAgeMinutes,LongestEpisodeMinutes,FirstObserved,LastObserved,
EpisodeAtEnd,Reason,Role,FixedRamGiB,AffectedFlag,UnknownFlag

| where Computer==Selected
| order by AffectedFlag desc,UnknownFlag desc,Computer asc

ContextTruncated=iff(array_length(Conditions)>64,1,0),

) on RuleKey
| extend RuleDefinitionMatches=array_length(ConfiguredRuleIds)
| extend GroupScopeEvidence=case(RuleDefinitionMatches>1,

'EVALUABLE WINDOW','NoEvaluableWindow')
| extend Lifecycle=case(WindowState=='NoEvaluableWindow','CURRENT snapshot / selected-window classification not evaluated',
MonitorCondition=='Fired','CURRENT FIRED snapshot',
MonitorCondition=='Resolved' and isnull(ResolvedAt),'RESOLVED / recovery time unavailable',
MonitorCondition=='Resolved' and ResolvedAt>=SelectedStart and ResolvedAt<SelectedEnd,'RECOVERED in selected window',
MonitorCondition=='Resolved' and ResolvedAt<SelectedStart,'HISTORICAL resolved before window',
MonitorCondition=='Resolved','RESOLVED after selected window / no as-of-state guarantee','UNKNOWN native condition'),
FiredWindowRelation=case(WindowState=='NoEvaluableWindow','NoEvaluableWindow',
isnull(FiredAt),'Original fired timestamp unavailable',
FiredAt<SelectedStart,'Original fired BEFORE window',FiredAt>=SelectedEnd,'Original fired AFTER window',

FiredOffsetFromWindowStartMinutes=(FiredAt-SelectedStart)/1m,
RuleName=tostring(split(AlertRule,'/')[-1]),
CurrentFiredFlag=iff(MonitorCondition=='Fired',1,0),
RecoveredInWindowFlag=iff(WindowState=='NoEvaluableWindow',int(null),
iff(MonitorCondition=='Resolved' and isnotnull(ResolvedAt)
and ResolvedAt>=SelectedStart and ResolvedAt<SelectedEnd,1,0)),
AttributionNextCheck=iff(Computer=='Unattributed',
'Read existing alert instance context in Azure portal; verify actual identity dimensions, not rule-name guesses',
'Compare exact identity and original timestamps with sampled evidence; attribution is not causality'),
OpenAlert='Native instance',
PortalUrl=strcat('https://portal.azure.com/#resource',id,'/overview')
| project id,OpenAlert,PortalUrl,Computer,Attribution,Lifecycle,Severity,MonitorCondition,AlertState,
RuleName,AlertRule,TargetResourceId,FiredAt,ResolvedAt,LastModified,SnapshotReturnedAt,WindowState,
FiredWindowRelation,FiredOffsetFromWindowStartMinutes,ContextPath,DimensionMachines,InvalidIdentityDimensions,
ContextExpansionTruncated,RawDimensions,GroupScopeEvidence,RuleDefinitionMatches,ConfiguredRuleIds,
ConfiguredRuleScopes,ConfiguredRuleCriteria,AttributionNextCheck,Description,
CurrentFiredFlag,RecoveredInWindowFlag

| where Computer==${machine:singlequote}
| order by FiredAt desc

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let IntervalStart=$__timeFrom();
let IntervalEnd=$__timeTo();
let FirstBucket=bin(IntervalStart,1m)+iff(IntervalStart>bin(IntervalStart,1m),1m,0m);
let LastBucket=bin(IntervalEnd,1m)-1m;
let WindowApproved=IntervalEnd-IntervalStart>=1m and IntervalEnd-IntervalStart<=4h and FirstBucket<=LastBucket;
let ExpectedMinutes=iff(WindowApproved,toint((LastBucket-FirstBucket)/1m)+1,0);
let SafeFirst=iff(WindowApproved,FirstBucket,IntervalEnd);
let SafeLast=iff(WindowApproved,LastBucket,IntervalEnd-1m);
let buckets=range Bucket from SafeFirst to SafeLast step 1m | where WindowApproved;
let Selected=${machine:singlequote};
Perf
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where WindowApproved and TimeGenerated>=IntervalEnd-4h and TimeGenerated<IntervalEnd
| where Computer in~ ('HV-HOST-01','SQL2019-GUEST','WIN2019-GUEST','WIN2022-GUEST','WIN2025-GUEST-01','RHEL94-GUEST')
| where isempty(tolower(tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId','')))) or tolower(tostring(column_ifexists('_ResourceId',''))) startswith '/subscriptions/<SUBSCRIPTION_ID>/resourcegroups/rg-hyperv-arc-monitor-demo/'
| extend Computer=toupper(Computer)
| where Computer==Selected or (Computer=='HV-HOST-01' and ObjectName startswith 'Hyper-V')
| where (ObjectName in ('LogicalDisk','Logical Disk') and CounterName in ('% Free Space','Free Megabytes','% Free Inodes'))
or (ObjectName=='Memory' and CounterName in ('Pages/sec','Page Reads/sec','Page Writes/sec',
'% Used Swap Space','Available MBytes Swap','Used MBytes Swap Space'))
or (ObjectName=='Paging File' and CounterName=='% Usage')
or (ObjectName=='Network Interface' and CounterName in ('Bytes Received/sec','Bytes Sent/sec',
'Packets Received Errors','Packets Outbound Errors'))
or (Computer=='RHEL94-GUEST' and ObjectName=='Network' and CounterName in
('Total Bytes Received','Total Bytes Transmitted','Total Rx Errors','Total Tx Errors'))
or (Computer=='SQL2019-GUEST' and Selected=='SQL2019-GUEST' and ObjectName=='Process' and InstanceName startswith 'sqlservr'
and CounterName in ('% Processor Time','Private Bytes','Working Set - Private'))
or (Computer=='HV-HOST-01' and ObjectName=='Hyper-V Hypervisor Root Virtual Processor'
and CounterName=='CPU Contention Time Per Dispatch')
or (Computer=='HV-HOST-01' and ObjectName=='Hyper-V Dynamic Memory Balancer' and CounterName=='Available Memory')
or (Computer=='HV-HOST-01' and ObjectName=='Hyper-V Dynamic Memory VM' and CounterName=='Physical Memory')
or (Computer=='HV-HOST-01' and ObjectName=='Hyper-V Virtual Storage Device' and InstanceName endswith '.vhdx'
and CounterName in ('Read Operations/Sec','Write Operations/Sec','Read Bytes/sec','Write Bytes/sec'))
| where isfinite(CounterValue)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,CounterValue),Mean=avg(CounterValue),Peak=max(CounterValue)
by Computer,ObjectName,CounterName,InstanceName
| extend Unit=case(ObjectName=='Network','RAW cumulative/unqualified; not a rate',
CounterName=='CPU Contention Time Per Dispatch','RAW contention/dispatch; unit unqualified',
ObjectName startswith 'Hyper-V Dynamic Memory','RAW memory unit unqualified',
ObjectName=='Process' and CounterName=='% Processor Time','raw CPU % may exceed 100',
CounterName contains '%','%',CounterName contains 'Bytes/sec','bytes/s',
CounterName contains 'Operations','operations/s','native named counter')
| project Computer,ObjectName,CounterName,InstanceName,LatestValue=CounterValue,Mean,Peak,Unit,LastSample=TimeGenerated

options.content:
**Heartbeat:** Existing agent heartbeat; machine/stream bucket occupancy, not business availability.

**Perf:** Existing collected counters; complete 1m sample occupancy and actual timestamps. No physical-core/NIC-speed inventory.

**HvSqlMemory_CL:** Exact SQL2019-GUEST / MSSQLSERVER, legacy MB means MiB. Cap is observed; categories overlap; no new SQL calls.

**HvLinuxDisk_CL:** RHEL block-device only; operations=IOPS*IntervalSeconds. Finite await denominator; idle N/A; aliases not additive.

**ConfigurationChange:** CT workspace recorded rows, first 200 ascending. Empty does not prove no change; event proximity is not cause.

**ConfigurationData:** CT recorded SQL-service inventory; not continuous SQL connectivity.

**ARG native alerts:** Current asynchronously indexed instance snapshot. Original fired/resolved timestamps differ from returned-now/modified.

**Alert identity:** Exact target ARM or one explicit allowlisted instance dimension. Configured rule scopes are group context ONLY.

**ARG Arc:** Current indexed inventory, never joined to historical placement.

**Configured graph:** Static baseline configuration; five guests on nested HV-HOST-01 plus SQL instance. Not discovery or WSFC.

**Confidence:** >=3 complete minutes; >=90% occupied buckets; <=2m longest gap; <=5m age at SELECTED END. Not continuous measurement.

**DEMO advisory:** CPU mean >=80%, RAM mean >=85%, minimum pending grants >0 for 3 consecutive complete 1m buckets. Not a business SLA.

**Storage / dispatch:** No approved universal health threshold; ns/dispatch is not Ready%; root contention unit unqualified.

**Missing coverage:** Unseen device/vCPU inventories unknown. RHEL processor queue NotCollected. Application availability not collected.

**CORE boundary:** Existing Logs / ARG / native alert context only; approved RG read-only access. No additional SQL telemetry interfaces or roles, guest SQL, Query Store, XE, agents, DCRs, instrumentation, probes, synthetic traffic, discovery, incident storage, forecasting, rightsizing, new alerts, remediation or AI-service calls. No business SLO is measured.
